findings.what: s13c bundles two changes: 花が彼を膝の上へ下ろす AND 魂火が二人のあいだに浮く.
findings.why: The soul-fire is 掌 through s13a (before) and floats between them only from s13c onward. Two visible changes in one shot.
findings.fix: Cut s13c into s13c (下ろす) and s13d (魂火が浮く), or rule explicitly that the floating is the same single receiving event.

findings.what: m01b 前→後 is 戸の隙の闇が深まり、敷居の前で止まる — 止まる has no subject, and it bundles the darkening with the presence-stopping.
findings.why: Source M01 is 気配が戸の前で止まる; the design dropped 気配, so 止まる dangles, and 闇が深まる is a second event.
findings.fix: Keep only 闇が深まる as the one change, or restore the subject and pick which single change m01b carries.

findings.what: 後 is 火が腕の中で揺れ続け、腕は離さない — the second clause is a negation.
findings.why: 接地は肯定形で書く; 離さない is the absence of releasing.

findings.what: 前→後 is 火は漂っている → 「コダマ」という声が一度鳴り、火が彼の足元で止まる — the voice is written into the change column.
findings.why: The change column carries the one visible change; audio belongs to 音.
findings.fix: after は「火が彼の足元で止まる」だけに。声は音欄。

findings.what: 後 is 腕が動き、記憶が切れる — two named.
findings.why: The rule makes the cut a consequence of the arm moving; as written it names two.
findings.fix: 「腕が動き、それが記憶を切る」の一変化と確認するか、現在への戻りを別ショットに。

findings.what: 火を見ている → 彼の目を見る — the subtlest gaze shift.
findings.why: It is visible but only legible if framed on the eyes.
findings.fix: 目元の寄りと明記するか、s10b へ畳む。

findings.what: The ep05 index row still reads 2:00, while ep05.md records M行 2:02／承2:30.
findings.why: ep03's index was updated; ep05's was left at the 台帳 value.
findings.fix: index を 2:02 に（または台帳の目標値と注記）。

note: v02 is substantially complete: 27 shots/420s, the four major multi-change rows cut, the negations positive, the count from the cut. Two multi-change rows remain: s13c (lowering + floating) and m01b (darkening + subject-less 止まる).
